item.title: Ariana Grande Drops ‘American Horror Story’ Season 13 Amid Touring Schedule
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the entertainment industry. Today, we're talking about Ariana Grande and her highly anticipated appearance on American Horror Story. But, it looks like that's not happening after all."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "According to reports, Grande's exit from the show is due to a scheduling conflict with her ongoing Eternal Sunshine Tour. The tour, which kicked off in June, has already seen some changes, with three dates rescheduled due to production issues. It seems that the tour is taking priority, and Grande didn't even get a chance to shoot any scenes for the show."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of American Horror Story theme]
Host: "American Horror Story: 13 is still moving forward, with a star-studded cast, including Sarah Paulson, Evan Peters, and Angela Bassett. The season is set to premiere on September 24th on FX and will stream on Hulu. But, Grande's fans will have to wait for her next project, which includes her eighth studio album, Petal, dropping on July 31st, and a role in the upcoming film, Focker-In-Law, a sequel to Meet the Parents."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
